what: A photo set (photo + two logo badges + phone screen) changes to the next set every 3 seconds, and one word of the large title beside it is tinted with that set’s color in .2s ease-out. On each change the badges pop out from 0x · ∓10° in .4s ease-out and the phone rises from 90px below in .3s ease-out — a case switcher showing ”In your brand color”

options.[data-fx-part=item]: One group — colour is the style’s --tone (skin variable recommended) or data-color. The group shown first gets is-displayed
options.[data-fx-part=pop]: Sticker that pops out when the group appears (optional) — initial tilt set with --fx-turn in style (default -10deg)
options.[data-fx-part=rise]: What rises from below when a group appears (optional) — distance via --fx-rise (default 90px)

use: Your colours
note: As in the original, the first tick (3s) shows the current set once more, and the real change starts at 6s

from.where: index.html .se-colors — original template_alternate-logo-image-text.js (setInterval 3s, moves is-displayed, sets .js-alt-word color from data-color) · .css (logo fadeIn·fadeIn2 .4s ease-out, phone fadeUp bottom −100→−10px .3s ease-out, .js-alt-word color .2s ease-out)
